// Loop over input items and add a new field called 'myNewField' to the JSON of each one
for (const item of $input.all()) {
  item.json.pgTuningQueries = [
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET shared_buffers = '2GB'",              
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET effective_cache_size = '6GB'",        
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET work_mem = '32MB'",                   
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET maintenance_work_mem = '512MB'",      
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_connections = '400'",             
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET superuser_reserved_connections = '3'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET wal_buffers = '16MB'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET checkpoint_completion_target = '0.9'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_wal_size = '4GB'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET min_wal_size = '1GB'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET wal_compression = 'on'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET random_page_cost = '1.1'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET seq_page_cost = '1.0'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET effective_io_concurrency = '100'",    
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET synchronous_commit = 'off'",          
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET commit_delay = '10'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET commit_siblings = '5'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET autovacuum_max_workers = '3'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET autovacuum_naptime = '30s'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit = '1500'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor = '0.05'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_worker_processes = '8'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_parallel_workers_per_gather = '4'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_parallel_workers = '8'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_parallel_maintenance_workers = '4'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET track_io_timing = 'on'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET track_functions = 'all'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET log_min_duration_statement = '500'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET temp_buffers = '128MB'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET default_statistics_target = '200'",
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET jit = 'off'",                         
  "ALTER SYSTEM SET huge_pages = 'try'"
];
}

return $input.all();
